<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אייר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918574_theRebbe_925" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_99_D7_99_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918574_theRebbe_925__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Based on the known concept that Torah and mitzvos are like lights and vessels, the connection through Torah study involves both the revealed aspect and the essence of Torah, which is above revelation, leading to two modes of connection between Israel, Torah, and the Holy One.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And according to the known concept</t>
    <t s="1">that Torah and mitzvos are</t>
    <t s="2">(like)</t>
    <t s="3">lights and vessels,</t>
    <t s="4">it must be said,</t>
    <t s="5">that also the connection through the engagement in Torah</t>
    <t s="6">(as the Torah is in the aspect of extension and revelation)</t>
    <t s="7">is included in the matter of deveikut,</t>
    <t s="8">and the matter of the bond through the engagement in Torah</t>
    <t s="9">[for Yisrael are bound in the Torah and the Torah in the Holy One, blessed be He],</t>
    <t s="10">is from the aspect of the essence of Torah that is above extension and revelation.</t>
    <t s="11">And this will be understood according to the known concept</t>
    <t s="12">that in the bond of Yisrael, Torah, and the Holy One, blessed be He, there are two modes.</t>
    <t s="13">For from the aspect of the Torah as it is drawn down in the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="14">since the order of the chain of descent is that the externality of the upper becomes the internality of the lower,</t>
    <t s="15">the mode of the bond of Yisrael in the Torah is that the hidden</t>
    <t s="16">(the internality)</t>
    <t s="17">of Yisrael is bound in the revealed</t>
    <t s="18">(externality)</t>
    <t s="19">of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="20">and likewise in the bond of the Torah in the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="21">that the hidden and the internality of the Torah is bound in the revealed of the Holy One, blessed be He.</t>
    <t s="22">And in this mode,</t>
    <t s="23">the bond of the revealed of Yisrael with the hidden of the Holy One, blessed be He, is through several intermediaries</t>
    <t s="24">(the hidden of Yisrael,</t>
    <t s="25">the revealed of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="26">the hidden of the Torah and the revealed of the Holy One, blessed be He).</t>
    <t s="27">But from the aspect of the essence of Torah,</t>
    <t s="28">as it is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="29">the bond of Yisrael in the Holy One, blessed be He, is that even the revealed of Yisrael is bound in the hidden of the Holy One, blessed be He, without intermediaries.</t>
    <t s="30">And even when he studies the revealed of the Torah with his understanding and comprehension, he is bound</t>
    <t s="31">(even the revealed of his soul,</t>
    <t s="32">even to his understanding and comprehension)</t>
    <t s="33">also with the hidden of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="34">and through it — with the hidden of the Holy One, blessed be He.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The bond of Yisrael and Torah from the level of Torah as drawn down in the chain of descent is included in the aspect of deveikut that is in externality, while the three bonds primarily refer to the bond from the essence of Torah above the chain of descent, which is in the hidden and internality.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it must be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that the bond of Yisrael and Torah that is from the level of Torah as it is drawn down in the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="2">is included in the matter of deveikut that is in externality.</t>
    <t s="3">For the bond of Yisrael in the Torah</t>
    <t s="4">(that is from this level)</t>
    <t s="5">is in the externality</t>
    <t s="6">(revealed)</t>
    <t s="7">of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="8">and furthermore,</t>
    <t s="9">even the internality within this aspect is as it is drawn down in the chain of descent to be an intermediary.</t>
    <t s="10">And the phrase "three bonds are bound one in the other" is</t>
    <t s="11">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="12">in the bond that is from the aspect of the essence of Torah that is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="13">for this bond is in the hidden of the Torah and in the hidden of the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="14">internality.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Even in the bond from the essence of Torah, Yisrael, Torah, and the Holy One are two separate things that connect, unlike the state where they are entirely one; the third bond is the direct bond of Yisrael and the Holy One from the root of Yisrael in Atzmus, which is above the root of Torah, forming a circular order.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">e)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, even in the bond that is from the aspect of the essence of Torah,</t>
    <t s="2">Yisrael and Torah, and likewise Torah and the Holy One, blessed be He, are like two things that are bound one to the other.</t>
    <t s="3">But not so is the state that Yisrael, Torah, and the Holy One, blessed be He, are all one,</t>
    <t s="4">which is above the bond of Yisrael, Torah, and the Holy One, blessed be He, as it is from the aspect of the essence of Torah that is above the chain of descent.</t>
    <t s="5">And this will be understood by prefacing the precise point in what they said, "three bonds are bound one in the other,"</t>
    <t s="6">for seemingly there are only two bonds,</t>
    <t s="7">that Yisrael are bound in the Torah and the Torah in the Holy One, blessed be He.</t>
    <t s="8">And one of the explanations of this is,</t>
    <t s="9">that the third bond is the bond of Yisrael and the Holy One, blessed be He, not through the medium of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="10">from the aspect that the root of Yisrael is in Atzmus,</t>
    <t s="11">which is above</t>
    <t s="12">the root of Torah.</t>
    <t s="13">And the order of these three bonds is like a ring</t>
    <t s="14">(a circle)</t>
    <t s="15">that has no beginning or end.</t>
    <t s="16">That at first Yisrael are bound in the Torah and the Torah in the Holy One, blessed be He, and afterwards the bond of the Holy One, blessed be He, and Yisrael,</t>
    <t s="17">for it must be said that after Yisrael are bound in the Torah and through it in the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="18">the root of Yisrael that is above the root of Torah is revealed,</t>
    <t s="19">the bond of Yisrael and the Holy One, blessed be He.</t>
    <t s="20">And after this bond is made</t>
    <t s="21">(of Yisrael and the Holy One, blessed be He),</t>
    <t s="22">then at first is the bond of Yisrael and the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="23">and after the root of Yisrael is revealed in His very Essence,</t>
    <t s="24">they draw this also into the Torah,</t>
    <t s="25">in the manner that Dovid would connect the supernal Torah with the Holy One, blessed be He.</t>
    <t s="26">For in addition to the Torah being the wisdom of the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="27">for wisdom is incomparable relative to the Essence of Ein Sof, and Yisrael draw into it the Essence of Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="28">behold, since also in the root of Torah and Yisrael as they are in Atzmus,</t>
    <t s="29">the root of Yisrael is above the root of Torah,</t>
    <t s="30">therefore through the engagement in Torah of Yisrael, the very Essence is drawn into it.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
